messages.subject: [acs-r] Make "204 No Content" an acceptable status code
messages.subject_clean: [acs-r] Make "204 No Content" an acceptable status code
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

First of all, thanks for creating this awesome tool.

I found that when fetching data for a (valid) geographic unit without any data, census.gov API returns status code 204. But `acs` code breaks in this case.

Wouldn?t it be nicer if it just returns empty values?



Thanks,
Jianchao

messages.body_plain:
Thanks for your email, and for using the package.  The package is
pretty bad at this sort of "error-handling," and I agree it would be
great if it was smarter about it -- maybe issuing a warning but still
returning a well-formatted, empty acs object, as you suggest.

The package is long overdue for an update, partially because I'm sort
of looking for someone to help with maintenance and future development
(any interest?), but I'll definitely add this to the "feature request"
list.

Thanks.

--Ezra
